title: William W. Carty
clean_html:
William W. Carty

Preserved Primary Document • carty-w2.htm

William Washington Carty, the son of William and Elizabeth Carty , was born in Caroline Co., MD on 14 April, 1818. He lived all of his life in Caroline Co. MD, dying there on 3 August, 1880. Sometime before 1863, William married Sarah Morgan , the daughter of William and Annie Sanders Morgan from Kent Co., DE. After her husband's death in 1800, Sarah Carter returned to Kent Co., DE were some of her children were already living. William and Sarah had the following children : William Eugene "Gene" Carty (b. December 1862/3) married Maude (Mosley or Ridgway??) They had the following children: Howard Carty Bertha M. Carty John W. Carty Gene Carty who married Isabelle Snowden John N. Carty (b.October 1864/5) married Elizabeth (CLARK?) They had the following children: Sarah Carter who married Thomas HALL Mabel Carter who married Ashton PIERCE and William WRIGHT Mary Carter Hattie Carter Irving Carter Elenora Carter Annie Elizabeth Carty (b.c. 1867) married George MOSLEY from Kent Co., DE They had the following children: Lola Mosley married Elwood BROWN Elmira Mosley married Roscoe MILLER Herbert Mosley married Anna GOULD Elmira Carty (b.1869) married Robert B. JOHNSON They had the following children: Rose Johnson Madeline Johnson William Johnson James E. Carty (b. October 1871/2) married Laura DEAN and then Emma Jane CUFF Jeanette Carty (b.1872) married Elijah BENSON Marion Carty (b.August 1874)
